name: Ouji (boy style Lolita)
description: Masculine Lolita: prince pants, masculine blouses and top hats.

name: Yamanba
description: Extreme ganguro: silver hair, white eye makeup and lipstick set against deep tan, candy-colour outfits.

name: Gyaruo (gal-o)
description: Male gyaru: styled big blond hair, deep tan, flashy accessories.

name: LA gyaru
description: Gyaru modelled on Los Angeles fashion: wheat-tan skin and colourful primary-colour outfits.

name: Shiro gyaru (white gyaru)
description: Gyaru who avoid tanning, pale skin, opposite of kuro gyaru.

name: Amuraa
description: Copies singer Namie Amuro: long boots, straight long hair, her make-up.

name: Salon boys
description: Stylists' look: designer pieces mixed with vintage, belts, classic hats, retro glasses.

name: Kireime kei
description: Neat, classic, well-fitted clothes: nice jeans, crisp shirts, good shoes, corduroy jackets.

name: Shibu-kaji (Shibuya casual)
description: Japan's first street fashion, born at Shibuya Center-gai; later branched to kirekaji and Ura-Hara.
notes: Garments not described; kirekaji (キレカジ) named as successor.

name: Miyuki-zoku
description: 1964 Ginza youth: button-down oxford, madras, khaki high-water trousers, penny loafers, slim three-button jackets.
notes: Origin of Japanese Ivy; move? Japanese street fashion

name: Peeps
description: 90s-inspired sporty goth style.

name: Shamate
description: Eye make-up, studded leather, slashed jeans, fishnets, large colourful spiky hair; from Visual Kei, goth, punk.

name: Sankeng (three traps)
description: Chinese umbrella for three costly niche dress genres: JK uniform, hanfu and Lolita.

name: JK uniform fashion
description: Japanese schoolgirl uniform worn as fashion: Western-style blouse, skirt, vest, cardigan, or sailor suit with collar stripes.

name: Cyberpunk hanfu
description: Hanfu recoloured and re-fabricated with a bold, dark cyberpunk look.

name: Ulzzang
description: Soft selfie look of the 2010s, declining in Seoul.

name: Jejemon
description: Stereotyped Filipino youth look: black shirts, brown pants or joggers, hip-hop gangsta clothing; high-crown caps.

name: Ah Beng and Ah Lian (Singapore)
description: 1990s Ah Lian: Fendi hair clips, platform shoes, high socks, Giordano windbreakers, neon backpacks; Ah Beng flamboyant.

name: Đôn chề
description: Vietnamese flashy streetwear: fake logo tees, tight jeans, eagle-wing bombers, loafers or sliders, fake gold chains.

name: Citayam Fashion Week (SCBD style)
description: Jakarta teens mixing unbranded and knock-off clothes with local brands in a low-cost take on branded fashion.

name: Skena (Indonesia)
description: Indonesian scene-linked dress: retro clothes modified for today with accessories; band tees and vintage pieces.

name: Thai sabai-with-jeans hybrid fashion
description: Diagonal sabai sash or heirloom Thai textile worn with jeans and modern clothes.

name: Pokemón (Chile)
description: Angular pressed hair, emo side bangs, otaku, punk and hip-hop clothing; Chilean mid-2000s, extinct by 2012.

name: Flogger
description: Converse-style high-tops, jeans tight to the calf, loose brightly coloured tops.

name: Skato
description: Short jeans, baggy tees, wide big-soled shoes, caps or head scarves.

name: Chaca
description: Mexican tribu urbana with showy taste and religious accessories.

name: Smarteez
description: Soweto crew dressing in loud bright colours with reworked thrifted Johannesburg pieces, township punk energy.
notes: Sub-scene of South African street style.

name: Lagos streetwear
description: Streetwear with hip-hop and skate roots, early-2000s Nollywood and Y2K blend, bold.

name: Cape Town streetwear
description: Coastal streetwear from local labels, workwear-inspired jackets, roomy tees, skate pieces.

name: Blokecore (ladcore)
description: Replica football shirts, Adidas track tops, good jeans and trainers; Britpop-era revival.

name: Dadcore
description: Dad jeans, trainers, plain tees, socks and sandals.

name: Warcore
description: Military-inspired streetwear: cargo pockets, utility straps; field jackets and covert coats.

name: Campcore and utilitycore
description: Waterproofs and thermals; hiking boots, zip jackets, cargo pants, work boots.

name: Westerncore (cowboycore)
description: Good denim, tan jacket, leather boots, western hat, fringe.

name: Poetcore
description: Loose knitwear, messenger bag, unstructured jackets, wool scarves and corduroy.

name: Coastal grandfather
description: Linen, loafers and neutral tones in a relaxed, weathered look.

name: Indie sleaze
description: Skinny jeans and leather jackets from early-2010s nightlife.

name: Sprezzatura
description: Deliberately undone details over well-fitted tailoring: open cardigan buttons, unbuttoned cuff, long tie blade.

name: Business casual
description: Dress shirt with chinos, optional sport coat or sweater, often no tie, leather dress shoes.

name: Pre-war motorcycle elegance
description: 1920s-30s English riders in tailored suiting, sheepskin blousons and aviation goggles.

name: Sartorial motorcycling (Distinguished Gentleman's Ride)
description: Tweed hacking jackets, suede gilets, denim blazers, heritage clothing on classic bikes; Prussian riding boots.

name: Apres-ski style
description: Chunky knits, quilted parkas, puffers, Nordic sweaters, fur boots worn after skiing.
